hello all,

parts:
Hi Sanjiv,

I assume you have ui.R and server.R saved in the folder 'C:/Users/Sanj/Desktop/shinyapp". If so, just run the following:

setwd('C:/Users/Sanj/Desktop/shinyapp')
library(shiny)
runApp()
